written: 2026-11-03, session 1d-i: from real QSMs only, before any simulated tree was measured again (designed after v1 failed)

rules.datasets_note: oak is gated at Wytham only (the user, 2026-11-03): BioDiv has no oaks, so no control can set an oak d_min there; v1 gated oak at BioDiv's beech resolution and failed it there (×1: 7 of 19). Demol is beech's held-out site (the 1d brief, 4): its control curve is reported, never gated
rules.d_min: per dataset, the largest point of the grid (the [1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 50] percentiles of its pooled terminal raw diameters) at which, for every gated species of the dataset, >= 90% of its gated descriptors have >= 90% of its real trees within tolerance after coarsen() (control.py). Gated: not report-only, not H1-excluded, not held out by the noise floor. A NaN original leaves the tree; a NaN after coarsening is outside. No point passes: the dataset stops. The bracket ×0.5/×2 is withdrawn

stress.source: Demol et al. 2022, Silva Fennica 56(1) 10550: branches under ≈ 5 cm carry 80–83% of the QSM volume overestimate (Table 3); the completeness threshold the 1d brief names

rules.inflation: Demol et al. 2022 (§3.2, Table 3): diameter +73% under 2.5 cm, +4% over 10 cm, log-interpolated between (not measured). Gated at d_min for both tiers (the user, 2026-11-03). Order: inflate, prune, re-cut
rules.evaluation_points: d_min, every grid point strictly inside (d_min, 2·d_min), 2·d_min, and inflation at d_min (tiers.evaluation_points)
rules.tier_a: resolution-independent: per seed, the median over the stand's live measured trees of the signed describe(coarsen(tree)) − describe(tree); |median| <= tolerance on >= 15 of the 20 seeds at every evaluation point (tiers.tier_a)
rules.tier_b: valid at matched resolution: per seed, the median of the signed v(p) − v(d_min); |median| <= tolerance on >= 15 of the 20 seeds at every other evaluation point, inflation against v(d_min); and the descriptor's control neutral at d_min (>= 90% of real trees within tolerance) (tiers.tier_b)
rules.assign: A if tier A passes, else B if tier B passes, else held out (tiers.assign). Both tiers are targets; the fit always compares the coarsened simulator against the real QSMs, never fine simulated values
rules.fail: a seed with no live measured tree, or a NaN difference on any tree, fails that seed
rules.held_out: noise floor >= 0.5 × between-tree SD, fewer than MIN_TREES finite real trees, or neither tier passes. Report-only (ldSlope, junctionDelta) and H1-excluded descriptors are neither targets nor hold-outs
rules.survive: per species, over its gated descriptors: if fewer than half reach a tier, stop and report; never loosen (amendment E)

size_match.reference: the median measured DBH of the species' tolerance set (R2): oak Wytham's DBH_pts, maple Wytham's sycamores' DBH_pts, beech BioDiv's dTLS (the user, 2026-11-03, extending the 1d brief's 4); values in `reference_dbh`
size_match.simulated: the converter's DBH (describe()'s, cylinders.py's rule) on the uncoarsened live measured trees
size_match.stand: the first season of stand_seasons at which the median over seeds 1–20 of the per-seed median DBH of the stand's live measured trees reaches the reference median. None by 300 (a compute bound): report and stop
size_match.lone: the same on the lone tree's DBH, at seasons 50–100 by 10. Not reached by 100: read at 100 and report the shortfall
size_match.report: the median height at the chosen season, beside the reference's

rules.control: every gated species' real QSMs of each dataset coarsened at each grid point and at the stress point (full coarsen(), and prune only); re-cut only once (it does not depend on d). Reported in full

h1_note: oak: the user's ruling; maple: extended (same dataset), confirmed (the 1d brief, 3)

rules.inflation: Demol et al. 2022 (Silva Fennica 56(1) 10550, §3.2, Table 3): diameter +73% under 2.5 cm, +4% over 10 cm, both measured on two leaf-off Fraxinus; log-interpolated between (not measured). One bracket point, at d_min × 1. Order: inflate, prune, re-cut
rules.datasets_note: BioDiv's resolution is measured on its beech (the only BioDiv QSMs fetched) and applied to oak
rules.shift: per seed, the median over the stand's live measured trees (STAND_MEASURED, alive at 150) of describe(coarsen(tree)) − describe(tree)
rules.pass: |shift| <= tolerance on >= 15 of the 20 seeds, at every bracket point and the inflation point, at each of the species' datasets
rules.fail: a seed with no live measured tree, or a NaN shift (the descriptor not computable at the resolution), counts as a fail
rules.held_out: gate c failed, or noise floor >= 0.5 × between-tree SD, or fewer than MIN_TREES finite real trees
rules.survive: per species, over its gated descriptors (DESCRIPTORS less report-only and H1-excluded): if fewer than half pass, stop and report; never loosen
rules.h2: ldSlope under the inflation point moves toward the dataset's QSM median: the gap closed is median shift / (QSM median − simulated median, uncoarsened), on beech at Demol and BioDiv. 'Hard' means at least half the gap closed
rules.h3: tortuosity and tortuosity05 (0.5 m resampling) reported on the real QSMs, the simulated trees and the coarsened ones
rules.control: each real QSM coarsened at its own dataset's resolution (× 1, no inflation): the shift should be near zero; a large one says the re-cut moves the descriptor by construction
